build_cmake_project: build a CMake-based project by configuring, compiling, and installing with Ninja generator and RelWithDebInfo
build_make_project: build a Make-based project by running make with parallel jobs and installing to a prefix directory
build_cargo_workspace: build a Rust Cargo workspace with vendored crates and install binaries to the output directory
run_cmake_tests: run CMake tests via ctest with retry logic, test filtering, and optional testpilot integration
run_cargo_tests: run Cargo test suite across workspace manifests with optional test filtering and doc generation
